name: commit-video
description: The Buffer Commit demo video for Dailies, edited in Remotion. Footage, renders and node_modules are not in git.

scripts.still: node scan.mjs && remotion still src/index.jsx Demo
scripts.render: ./prep.sh && node scan.mjs && node gen-music.mjs public/music.wav && remotion render src/index.jsx Demo --concurrency=6 --timeout=90000
